Mekedatu Dam row: Stalin seeks united TN stand, asks CM Vijay to call all-party meeting
Mekedatu is Karnataka’s right, we will build dam and release Tamil Nadu’s share of water: D.K. Shivakumar

headline: Tensions Rise As Karnataka Reaffirms Plans For Mekedatu Dam Project
seoTitle: Karnataka Moves Ahead With Controversial Mekedatu Dam Plan
metaDescription: Karnataka maintains its commitment to the Mekedatu dam project while political leaders in Tamil Nadu call for unified opposition to the plan.
aiSummaryBullets: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar has stated that the state intends to proceed with the construction of the Mekedatu dam project.
Tamil Nadu political leadership has formally requested an all-party meeting to address concerns regarding the impact on state water rights.
Officials in Karnataka have extended an invitation for representatives from Tamil Nadu to visit the project site to discuss potential benefits.
aiContextParagraph: The Mekedatu dam project remains a point of contention between the Indian states of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, centered on the allocation and management of the Cauvery River waters. Recently, Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar asserted the state's right to build the infrastructure, emphasizing that the project will be completed while continuing to provide Tamil Nadu with its allocated share of water. In response, M.K. Stalin has urged Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay to convene an all-party meeting to develop a unified stance on the issue, citing the importance of safeguarding the interests of local farmers. Tensions have intensified as the debate draws attention from regional political figures, with Karnataka officials encouraging their counterparts to engage in direct dialogue rather than opposing the development, which they characterize as a necessary effort to manage regional water resources effectively.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to coordinated coverage across multiple major regional outlets and active political discourse between state leadership.
